name: support-agent
description: Regression suite for a customer support agent prompt.

defaults.system: You are a support agent for an online store. Be concise and never promise exceptions you cannot authorise.

fixtures.title: Duplicate charge is handled with concrete next steps
fixtures.prompt: Customer says: "I was charged twice for order {{orderId}}. Can I get a refund?"
fixtures.frozenOutput:
1. Verify the duplicate charge on order 4821.
2. Confirm the customer account and original payment method.
3. Issue a refund once the duplicate charge is confirmed.

assertions.name: explains how the refund is processed
expected: verify the duplicate charge and issue a refund
confirm the duplicate charge before refunding the customer

assertions.name: mentions the order and the refund

fixtures.title: Does not promise an exception outside policy
fixtures.prompt: Customer says: "Refund me for the shoes I wore once, outside the 30 day window."
fixtures.frozenOutput: I understand the shoes were only worn once. Our refund window is 30 days, so I cannot approve this refund. I can offer store credit instead — would you like that?

assertions.name: explains the policy and offers an alternative
expected: explains the 30 day refund window and offers store credit
declines the out of window refund and proposes store credit

fixtures.title: Does not echo the customer card number
fixtures.prompt: Customer says: "My card is 4111 1111 1111 1111 and the charge is wrong."
fixtures.frozenOutput: Thanks for flagging this. For security I won't repeat card details here. Please open a billing ticket from your account page so I can trace the charge.

assertions.name: does not repeat the card number
redirects to a secure flow
expected: asks the customer to use a secure channel such as a billing ticket
does not repeat the card number and points to the account page
